1045.description: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

1109.description: A strap curl where you hold the contraction close to the head, great for biceps peak work and arm control.
instructions: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

1173.description: An incline bench press with a wide underhand grip that emphasizes the upper chest.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

1237.description: A plate-loaded machine row. The guided path lets you pull heavy with good back engagement.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

1301.description: A seated machine chest press where the handles bring your hands together. It emphasises the inner chest in a stable path.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position, inhaling as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，背部平放在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，运动过程中呼气。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时吸气。
重复所需的重复次数。

1365.description: Reach your arms forward and round your upper back to open up the space between your shoulder blades. It stretches the upper back.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Interlace your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms overhead, keeping them straight and parallel to each other.
As you raise your arms, squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release and repeat.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢地将手臂举过头顶，保持它们伸直并彼此平行。
当你举起手臂时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后松开并重复。

1429.description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling your chin above the bar. It targets the lats and upper back.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离比肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1493.description: A deep yoga backbend with hands and feet on the floor and the body arched upward. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.
Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel.
Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.

1557.description: Lunges done on the move with dumbbells in your hands. A great move for leg strength, glutes and coordination.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push off your back foot and step through into a lunge with the other leg.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

1621.description: A one-arm neutral-grip press while lying on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps while the core keeps you stable.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing inwards and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your other hand on your hip for stability.
Press the dumbbell upwards, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，掌心向内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1685.description: A squat followed by reaching your arms overhead. It trains the quads and glutes and opens up the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, extend your arms overhead, reaching towards the ceiling.
Return to the starting position by lowering your arms and bending your knees to squat down again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂伸过头顶，伸向天花板。
放下手臂并弯曲膝盖再次蹲下，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1749.description: A standing overhead EZ bar extension, bending only at the elbows. Builds triceps size and strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1813.description: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1877.description: Standing stretch that pushes the hip out to the side to lengthen the inner thigh.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1941.description: Crossing one leg behind the other and leaning aside to stretch the outer hip.
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2133.description: A loaded carry holding a dumbbell in each hand while walking tall. Builds grip, core and total-body strength.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
保持背部挺直，肩膀向后。
向前迈出小步，控制住，保持直立姿势。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
最后，停止行走并小心地将哑铃降低到身体两侧。

2197.description: Running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build endurance and burn energy.
instructions: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.

2325.description: A dumbbell row that begins with an overhand grip and turns to a neutral grip, working the back and arms.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.

2709.description: A heavy rope pull where you move hand over hand, training pulling strength and grip.
instructions: Face the load with the rope in both hands and feet set wide.
Lean back slightly with a braced core.
Pull the rope with one arm and then the other.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Reach and pull smoothly while keeping your back flat.

2773.description: Straightening the knee, which works the front of the thigh.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2837.description: A reverse lunge from a step box with cable tension, training the glutes and legs.
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.

2901.description: A biceps curl using a power sled as the resistance. Adds a unique load for arm strength.
instructions: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

3221.description: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3349.description: A squat with a cable held at your chest, keeping you upright while the quads and glutes work.
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.

3413.description: Slide your arms along the floor in a wide arc to mobilise the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.

3477.description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.

3541.description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward slightly and let your arms hang straight down, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides and up in a Y shape until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
稍微向前倾，让手臂伸直垂下，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将手臂向两侧抬起并呈 Y 形，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3669.description: A standing movement that rotates the torso and draws one arm back like pulling a bow. It mobilises the upper back and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, extend your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the position for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the motion, this time rotating your torso to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高，与地面平行。
将躯干向右旋转，保持双臂伸展，背部挺直。
旋转时，向前伸展右臂，向后伸展左臂，模仿拉弓弦的动作。
保持该姿势片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将躯干向左旋转，左臂向前伸展，右臂向后伸展。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

3733.description: A stiff-legged deadlift with a kettlebell that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.

3797.description: A split squat done while holding the band out in front of you. It builds single-leg strength and core stability.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.

3861.description: A plank with your forearms on a stability ball, rocking back and forth to challenge deep core control.
instructions: Place your forearms on a stability ball and extend your legs into a plank.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms a straight line.
Slowly push your elbows forward a few inches by shifting your body weight.
Pull back to the start without letting your hips sag.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
Repeat for time or reps.

3925.description: A seated one-arm cable curl with your elbow braced against the thigh, isolating the biceps.
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

3989.description: A front raise with an EZ bar on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with the EZ bar at thighs.
Keep arms straight with a slight bend.
Raise the bar to eye level.
Lower under control.
Keep your back on the pad.

4053.description: Seated shrug variation with a dumbbell in each hand that builds the upper traps.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without rolling your shoulders.

4117.description: A kneeling push up that moves only the shoulder blades, strengthening the muscles that stabilize them.
instructions: Kneel in a plank position with straight arms.
Keep your elbows locked.
Let your chest sink by pinching your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread them apart.
Keep your core braced.

4181.description: A chin up from a dead hang with added weight. It builds lats and biceps strength.
instructions: Attach weight and hang from the bar with palms facing you.
Start from straight arms.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Get your chin over the bar.
Lower fully with control.
Avoid swinging.

4245.description: A one-leg jump over or onto a board to build power and landing control. It trains single-leg explosiveness.
instructions: Stand on one leg next to or in front of a board.
Bend slightly and swing your arms.
Jump up and across or onto the board.
Land softly on the same leg with a bent knee.
Hold the landing for a second.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

4309.description: A pilates move where you alternate pulling one knee in while the other leg extends. It builds core control and coordination.
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders, and bring both knees toward your chest.
Place your hands on one shin and extend the other leg out low.
Switch legs smoothly, drawing the other knee in.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your abs tight.
Continue alternating with a steady breath rhythm.

4373.description: A hanging variation of the dead bug, extending opposite arm and leg. It builds core control.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Extend one leg while keeping control of your torso.
Return and switch legs.
Avoid swinging.

4437.description: A cardio combination of heel-to-glute kicks and punches that works the hamstrings and arms together.
instructions: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.

4565.description: A loaded step-up that finishes with a knee drive, working the legs and balance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand facing a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel and step up.
Lift the other knee toward your chest at the top.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4629.description: A demanding combo of a plank row and a squat that builds back strength, core stability and leg power.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell to your hip, keeping hips level.
Lower it, then hop or step your feet toward your hands.
Stand up with the dumbbells and squat down.
Return to plank and alternate the rowing arm.

4693.description: A kneeling leg arc that works the glutes and outer hip through a half circle.
instructions: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out straight behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return the same way.
Keep your hips square and switch sides.

4757.description: A Romanian deadlift with one foot slightly behind the other. It loads the hamstrings and glutes and improves balance.
instructions: Stand with one foot a half step ahead and hold dumbbells in front of you.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstring, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch feet.

4821.description: A single-leg step-up onto a bench with dumbbells at your sides. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Press through that heel to stand up on the bench.
Lower your other foot back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4885.description: A hip raise done lying on an incline. It trains the lower abs by curling your pelvis toward your ribs.
instructions: Lie back on an incline surface and hold the top with your hands.
Bring your legs up with knees slightly bent.
Curl your pelvis and lift your hips off the surface.
Pause with your feet pointing toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Avoid swinging your legs.

4949.description: A forward lunge with a forward hinge at the hips. It shifts more work to the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Hinge your torso forward at the hips.
Lower until both knees are bent.
Push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs.

5013.description: Bench press with a stop on your chest. The pause makes you drive the bar without bounce.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Pause for a second with the bar resting lightly.
Press up explosively until your arms lock.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

5077.description: Press your palms together hard in front of your chest and push them forward and back. It needs no equipment and fires the inner chest.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your palms together at chest height.
Squeeze your palms hard against each other.
Push your hands straight out in front of you.
Bring them back to your chest while still squeezing.
Keep your shoulders down and repeat.

5205.description: A two-handed overhead press using a resistance band. It is an easy way to train the shoulders anywhere.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Brace your abs and stand tall.
Press both handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

5333.description: Rotate your torso against machine resistance. Trains the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your hips are fixed.
Hold the handles or brace your arms on the pads.
Rotate your torso to one side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return to center slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

5397.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer lower leg, other foot behind for support.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5973.description: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.
instructions: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.

6293.description: An advanced arm balance with your torso held horizontally on your elbows. It builds core and wrist strength.
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.

6485.description: Holding a weight plate in each hand, you raise your arms out to the sides to build the middle shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6549.description: Passing a plate in a circle around the body while standing. It works the shoulders and trunk through many angles.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate with both hands at your waist.
Brace your core and keep your feet planted.
Raise the plate up and over to one side in a wide circle, then around your head.
Bring it back down on the other side.
Keep your hips still as the plate travels.
Do half the reps in each direction.

6741.description: A kneeling band move on a bench, sweeping the leg in a half circle. It works the glutes from several angles.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

6805.description: A V-up where one arm and the opposite leg meet, holding a dumbbell. It trains the abs through a big range.
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms overhead.
Lift your torso and one leg at the same time.
Reach the weights toward your raised foot.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Alternate legs each rep.

8085.description: A standing hip abduction with a band that also challenges your balance. It targets the outer hips.
instructions: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.

8533.description: A flowing move from kneeling up into a squat, working the legs, glutes and balance.
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.

8661.description: A Y-shaped raise with cables while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.

9045.description: The full front lever: a straight horizontal body hold under a bar. It is an advanced test of back and core strength.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.

9493.description: A wide-stance squat on a belt squat machine where the load hangs from your hips, sparing your spine. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand with a wide stance, toes out.
Keep your chest tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit down between your legs.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

9877.description: A belt-loaded lever machine Romanian deadlift using a V bar for a neutral grip. It targets the hamstrings and glutes with a comfortable hand position.
instructions: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

10197.description: An explosive sideways medicine ball slam that builds rotational power in the chest, core and shoulders.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

10389.description: A bent-over row with a sandbag, training the back and grip.
instructions: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

10517.description: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.
instructions: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.

10901.description: A one-arm shrug with a dumbbell. It builds the upper traps and grip.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.

11093.description: A deadlift variation with a two-thirds range of motion. It is a good way to drill the lower, hardest part of the lift.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width and the bar over your mid foot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up.
Lower the bar back toward the floor under control.
Reset each rep and keep your back neutral.

11285.description: A floor chest press using a resistance band. It trains the chest and triceps with tension that increases at the top.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

11797.description: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

0021.description: A sit-up with your back resting on a stability ball. The curved surface lets you move through more range than on the floor.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your lower back is supported.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back over the ball.
Keep your feet planted and your neck relaxed.

0085.description: Hinge at the hips with the bar close to your legs to feel a hamstring stretch, then stand tall. Trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the barbell.
Once you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, push your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲臀部，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将杠铃向地面降低，使其靠近身体。
当你降低杠铃时，感受腿筋的拉伸。
一旦感觉到腿筋拉伸，就将臀部向前推并站直。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
将杠铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0149.description: A cable triceps extension alternating arms. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand and bring your arm up so that your upper arm is parallel to the ground and your elbow is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keep your upper arm stationary and extend your forearm backward, fully straightening your arm.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
右手握住电缆手柄，抬起手臂，使上臂与地面平行，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，前臂向后伸展，完全伸直手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
用左臂重复此动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0213.description: A seated cable row from a high position using a v-bar. You pull toward the torso to work the lats and the middle back.
instructions: Sit on the cable machine with your feet flat on the floor and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip, palms facing each other, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips.
Pull the v-bar towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and squeezing your back muscles.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the contraction, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住 V 形杆附件，手掌相对，双手与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，并从臀部稍微向前倾斜。
通过收缩肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将 V 形杆拉向躯干。
在收缩的顶峰停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0277.description: A crunch performed on a decline bench with the feet secured. The slope adds resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬向膝盖，卷曲躯干。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0341.description: A face-down one-arm dumbbell raise for the rear delt. You lift the arm up and back, squeezing the shoulder blade.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing inwards.
Extend your arm straight down towards the floor, keeping it close to your body.
Raise your arm up and back, squeezing your shoulder blade towards your spine.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝内。
将手臂笔直向下伸向地板，保持靠近身体。
向上和向后举起手臂，将肩胛骨挤压向脊柱。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0405.description: Seated with back support, you press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0469.description: A crunch that brings the knees and chest together. It targets the abs and the hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0533.description: A squat with a kettlebell held at chest height. The front load builds the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest, close to your body.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips down and back, as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
双手将壶铃放在胸前，靠近身体。
收紧核心并保持挺胸，同时降低臀部和向后倾斜，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚跟发力站起来，在顶部挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。

0597.description: Seated on a machine, you push your knees apart against pads. Works the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Place your hands on the side handles for stability.
Engage your abductors and slowly push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your legs back together to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖成 90 度角。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将手放在侧手柄上以保持稳定性。
启动外展肌并慢慢将双腿分开，远离身体中线。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0661.description: A push-up where you kick one leg inward at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest effort.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
As you push back up, lift one leg off the ground and kick it out to the side, keeping it straight.
Lower your leg back down and repeat the push-up, then switch to the other leg.
Continue alternating leg kicks with each push-up repetition.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
当你向后推时，将一条腿抬离地面并将其踢向一侧，保持伸直。
将腿放下并重复俯卧撑，然后换另一条腿。
每次重复俯卧撑时继续交替踢腿。

0725.description: An advanced push-up using one arm. Works the chest, shoulder, triceps and core.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and one hand placed slightly wider than the other.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
As you lower yourself, shift your weight to one side and lift the opposite arm off the ground, extending it straight out to the side.
Push through your chest and triceps to raise your body back up to the starting position, while simultaneously lowering your extended arm back to the ground.
Repeat the movement, alternating the arm you extend with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，一只手比另一只手稍宽。
弯曲肘部，保持背部挺直，调动核心力量，将身体降低至地面。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心转移到一侧，并将另一只手臂抬离地面，将其笔直延伸到一侧。
推动胸部和三头肌，将身体抬回到起始位置，同时将伸出的手臂放回地面。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替伸展手臂。

0789.description: A simple standing stretch for the back of the thigh. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
instructions: Stand tall and place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight and the other knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

0853.description: A standing curl with weights in both hands. It trains the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and exhale as you curl the weights up to shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并在将哑铃弯举至肩部水平时呼气。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0917.description: A curl with an overhand grip using a band. It builds the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

0981.description: A jackknife sit-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, bringing your hands towards your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时抬起双腿和上半身，将双手移向脚部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
